versions.changelog:
- Initial release of memory-anchor for OpenClaw agents, providing portable long-term memory with hybrid recall.
- Supports SQLite FTS5, keyword, associative expansion, and optional LLM embeddings for fact storage and search.
- Implements agent-only CLI commands for remember, recall, ingest, index, and session briefing.
- Includes explicit setup and embedding model management, compatible with Ollama and OpenAI.
- Designed for seamless user experience: users interact naturally, while agents manage all memory operations in the background.
- Detailed documentation and environment variable support for easy deployment and configuration.
